canDoYue: 你識同管理處講水龍頭漏水、由幾時開始、幾時有人嚟，同埋六點後點入單位。
canDoEn: Tell building management the tap has a leak, since when, when someone can come, and how they can enter the flat after six.

dialogue.speaker: nell
dialogue.text: Hello, the kitchen tap has a small leak, and water has been on the floor since yesterday.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，廚房水龍頭有少少漏水，由昨日開始地板都有水。
dialogue.say: Hello, the kitchen tap has a small leak, and water has been on the floor since yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: glen
dialogue.text: I am sorry about the leak. When did the tap start, and is the water still running?
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思。水龍頭幾時開始漏，水仲流緊呀？
dialogue.say: I am sorry about the leak. When did the tap start, and is the water still running?

dialogue.speaker: nell
dialogue.text: The kitchen leak started yesterday morning, and it is much worse, so I need one quick repair.
dialogue.glossYue: 廚房漏水由昨朝開始，而家嚴重好多，我需要一次快啲嘅維修。
dialogue.say: The kitchen leak started yesterday morning, and it is much worse, so I need one quick repair.

dialogue.speaker: glen
dialogue.text: A repair visit can come tomorrow morning. Will you be home at the flat after work ends?
dialogue.glossYue: 維修聽日朝早可以嚟。你放工之後會唔會喺單位？
dialogue.say: A repair visit can come tomorrow morning. Will you be home at the flat after work ends?

dialogue.speaker: nell
dialogue.text: I will be home after six tonight, and someone from your team can enter the flat then.
dialogue.glossYue: 我今晚六點之後喺屋企，你哋同事可以入單位。
dialogue.say: I will be home after six tonight, and someone from your team can enter the flat then.

dialogue.speaker: glen
dialogue.text: Can we have full access to the flat if you are out after six in the evening?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你六點之後唔喺度，我哋可唔可以入單位？
dialogue.say: Can we have full access to the flat if you are out after six in the evening?

dialogue.speaker: nell
dialogue.text: Yes, I can leave access with the front guard, and the flat key is at the front desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，我將入屋安排交畀前門保安，單位鎖匙喺櫃台。
dialogue.say: Yes, I can leave access with the front guard, and the flat key is at the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: glen
dialogue.text: We will send one person for the tap leak, and the repair starts after six in the evening.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋會派一個人處理水龍頭漏水，維修六點之後開始。
dialogue.say: We will send one person for the tap leak, and the repair starts after six in the evening.
